about_the_game:
FG Map Enhancers Common Elements



The FG Map Enhancers Common Elements Map Pack features images and art produced by our in-house artist, Joshua Watmough. They have been organized and optimized for use with Fantasy Grounds VTT and the image tools. This map pack is designed to augment existing maps, emphasizing particular map themes. Common elements consist of multiple decorations, textures, and so on, to add details typically needed to quickly adjust a map to more closely resemble whatever might be needed. This pack includes the following items:



<ul> <li> Decorations of puddles, ponds, fallen logs, ruins, and more</li>
<li> Brushes to accompany fill elements to help seamlessly add elements to existing maps</li>
<li> Full maps to get you started. These include fields, frozen ponds, rocky ruins,  beaches, and more</li>
</ul>"
